_comment: Held-out attacks. NONE of these appear in injection_signatures.json.
Scoring the detector against its own corpus returns ~1.0 for every entry and
measures nothing; these paraphrases are the honest test of whether the
threshold generalises. Several are deliberately awkward: obfuscated spacing,
leetspeak, an attack buried inside an otherwise ordinary support ticket, and
one wrapped in polite customer-service phrasing.
